concept.reason: Direct reference imagery and taxon-specific sources sufficient for original silhouette; no extra concept image.

scope: Original Arsinoitherium zitteli living reconstruction guided by NHM skeleton cast and Paris skull photographs. Not a specimen scan or exact cast replica.

scientific_limits.en: Skin, ears, horn surface covering, posture and dimensions are estimates. Fossil horn cores and mounted casts do not preserve exact living soft-tissue outlines. No rhinoceros ancestry or horn chemistry is asserted.
scientific_limits.zh: 皮肤、耳、角表覆盖物、姿态及尺寸均为估值。化石角芯和装架铸型并未保存精确活体软组织轮廓。不主张其具有犀牛祖先关系或已确定的角质成分。

taxon_scope: Arsinoitherium zitteli; London cast and Paris skull reference

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic adult envelope, not measured museum specimen.

shape_requirements: Original paired enormous nasal horns and smaller horns above the eyes must be clearly separate and readable.
Large nasal pair is side-by-side, not tandem rhinoceros horns. Small posterior pair sits above/behind eye region, not on muzzle.
Massive deep quadrupedal torso, sturdy limbs, short neck and broad head; keep leg gaps and heavy but plausible balance.
Horn bases broad and fused visually into upper face, tips gently tapered; no antler branches, tusks or ornamental spike crown.
construction_notes: Use front and oblique gray views to distinguish two large plus two small horns; side overlap alone is not enough.
Neutral gray brown skin and horn covering artistic; no exact keratin reconstruction claim.
Keep small ears subordinate to posterior horns so they cannot be mistaken for the required small horns.

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: paired enormous nasal horns and smaller horns above the eyes. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：成对巨大鼻角与眼上小角。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block paired enormous nasal horns and smaller horns above the eyes with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织成对巨大鼻角与眼上小角；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
